projects.title: SPARK - Simulated Patient AI for Reflective Knowledge
projects.description: SPARK is an LLM-powered simulated patient platform for health professions education. I built the instructor persona-authoring workflow, multi-turn conversational engine, persistent session state, cohort management, and learner review tooling. The platform has been deployed across two Canadian universities and used by 264 learners to date.

projects.title: Echo - AI Assistant for Rural Healthcare
projects.description: Echo is a production RAG-based conversational AI assistant for rural healthcare planners in Saskatchewan. I designed record-aware chunking over structured datasets, embedding and retrieval workflows, domain-constrained response boundaries, provenance surfacing, and evaluation methodology that showed 3.9x faster task completion than traditional retrieval in published testing.

projects.title: EchoPCR - AI-Assisted Paramedic Reporting
projects.description: EchoPCR is an AI clinical documentation system for paramedics. I built the streaming speech-to-text and LLM-driven structured JSON generation pipeline for patient care reports. Early trial results reduced documentation time from 45-120 minutes to 10-20 minutes per report, and the system is now in active field trial with La Ronge EMS.

projects.title: SREDER - AI-Assisted SR&ED Reporting
projects.description: SREDER is an AI-assisted SR&ED reporting platform for CRA-compliant technical documentation. I built the transcription, structured report generation, Stripe-based credit billing, and multi-tenant role-based access model. The system has generated 50+ reports in production while reducing report preparation time from 2-3 hours to under 20 minutes.

projects.title: VHH PATH - Virtual Care Implementation Platform
projects.description: I architected and delivered VHH PATH, a 10-module digital health ecosystem used by practitioners, planners, and administrators across Saskatchewan. The platform combines data systems, decision support, facility readiness workflows, technology evaluation, and AI-assisted planning in a single cloud-based environment.

projects.title: Canadian Historical GIS
projects.description: The Canadian Historical GIS platform gives researchers access to historical geospatial census data through interactive exploration, querying, and downloads. I built data infrastructure and web tooling that supported large-scale academic use and public access.

projects.title: Facility Profiles & Registration Portal
projects.description: A comprehensive portal designed for healthcare facilities to register with the Virtual Health Hub and manage their onboarding journey. The system supports data collection, multi-stage tracking, and facility engagement through conditional dashboards and dynamic forms.

projects.title: Site Scoring Tool
projects.description: An intelligent decision-support system that ranks rural communities based on multiple weighted criteria, such as population, distance to care, and existing infrastructure. This tool plays a pivotal role in prioritizing communities for virtual health interventions within the province.
